source.title: Letter 35
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 35

paragraphs.text: Damasus addresses five questions to Jerome with a request for information concerning them. They are:
1. What is the meaning of the words <quote>Whosoever slays Cain vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold</quote>? {{BIBLE:gen 4:5}}

2. If God has made all things good, how comes it that He gives charge to Noah concerning unclean animals, and says to Peter, <quote>What God has cleansed that call not thou common</quote>? {{BIBLE:act 10:15}}

3. How is Gen. xv. 16, <quote>in the fourth generation they shall come hither again,</quote> to be reconciled with Ex. xiii. 18, LXX, <quote>in the fifth generation the children of Israel went up out of the land of Egypt</quote>?
4. Why did Abraham receive circumcision as a seal of his faith? {{BIBLE:rom 4:11}}
5. Why was Isaac, a righteous man and dear to God, allowed by God to become the dupe of Jacob? {{NOTE:note1}} Written at Rome 384 A.D.

latex.p0003: 达玛稣向热罗尼莫提出五个问题，并请求关于这些问题的信息。它们是：
latex.p0004: 1. 这句话的意思是什么：\BibleQuote{凡击杀加音者，将受七倍的报复}？\BibleRef{创 4:5}
latex.p0005: 2. 如果天主创造了万有都是好的，为何祂向诺厄吩咐关于不洁的动物，并对伯多禄说：\BibleQuote{天主所洁净的，你不可称为污秽的}？\BibleRef{宗 10:15}
latex.p0006: 3. 如何使 \BibleQuote{到第四代，他们要再回到这里} \BibleRef{创 15:16} 与 \BibleQuote{到第五代，以色列子民从埃及地上来} \BibleRef{出 13:18}（七十贤士译本）相调和？
latex.p0007: 4. 为何亚巴郎接受割损作为他信德的印记？\BibleRef{罗 4:11}
latex.p0008: 5. 为何天主允许依撒格，一个义人且是天主所爱的，被雅各伯所欺骗？\EditorialNote{创世纪第27章} 写于罗马，公元三八四年。
